title: Back-Dating Reach of a Home Oxygen Therapy Setup Date by Coverage Class
content:
# Back-Dating Reach of the Setup Date — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy setup, the patient's first day at home replaces the initial-setup delivery date only when the first day at home is no more than the reach below before the day the setup is recorded. The reach depends on the coverage named on the oxygen record, read by its coverage class in the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are counted in calendar days as the later date minus the earlier date. When the condition fails, the setup day stays the initial-setup delivery date.

| Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Reach (days before the day the setup is recorded) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 |
| Commercial PPO | 180 |
| Commercial HMO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 |
| any other coverage class (for example Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 90 |

## Both sides of the figures (hypothetical)

| Coverage class | First day at home, days before the setup is recorded | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 366 | fails |
| Commercial HMO | 180 | met |
| Commercial HMO | 181 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 90 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 91 | fails |

## Points of judgement

**Whose coverage class decides the reach?** The coverage the oxygen record names, as its class appears on the coverage record.

**What is the reach measured to?** To the day the setup is recorded.
